name: MT Pulse Enabled
description: MTon acquisition must have magnetization transfer pulse enabled (indicated in ScanOptions or SequenceVariant).
implementation:
scan_options = str(value['ScanOptions'].iloc[0]) if 'ScanOptions' in value.columns else ''
seq_variant = str(value['SequenceVariant'].iloc[0]) if 'SequenceVariant' in value.columns else ''

if 'MT' not in scan_options.upper() and 'MTC' not in seq_variant.upper():
    raise ValidationError("MTon acquisition must have MT pulse enabled. Check ScanOptions or SequenceVariant for MT/MTC.")
